package.title: Auth resilience: global 401 refresh+replay with kick-out, 5xx retry with busy overlay (frontend + backend contract tests)

specification.intent: The 15-minute access cookie currently breaks every runtime request with a raw 401 until a page reload (only cold-boot /auth/me knows how to refresh), and 5xx responses just fail. Operator request: on a stale token transparently refresh and REPLAY the originally failed request; if refresh fails, kick the user out to the sign-in page; show a full-screen dimming overlay with a spinner and «Пожалуйста, ожидайте» plus three ANIMATED dots while refreshing; on 500 retry the request under the same overlay reading «Возможно, проблемы на сервере.. Мы пробуем переподключиться»; check frontend AND backend. Clarified 2026-11-03: 5xx retry covers ALL methods with 3 retries at 2s/6s/12s.

requirements.title: Backend: pin the refresh contract with integration tests
requirements.description: The backend ALREADY implements the contract (POST /auth/refresh with CSRF double-submit and one-shot rotation via token_version; get_current_user 401 details). This workstream adds the missing integration suite backend/tests/integration/auth/test_auth_refresh_api.py in the existing httpx/ASGITransport style: (1) login issues access/refresh/csrf cookies; (2) refresh with the csrf header returns 200 UserResponse and reissues all three cookies; (3) the PREVIOUS refresh cookie replayed answers 401 refresh_token_rotated (one-shot rotation pinned); (4) refresh without a cookie answers 401 refresh_required; (5) refresh without the csrf header answers 403 csrf_failed; (6) GET /chats without the access cookie answers 401 authentication_required and with a corrupted access cookie 401 invalid_token; (7) after a successful refresh the fresh access cookie authorizes GET /chats (200); (8) POST /auth/logout retires the refresh cookie (subsequent refresh 401). NO backend application code change is in scope; a discovered defect is a plan gap routed to the controller.

requirements.title: HTTPTransport policy hooks (401 replay, 5xx retry) + busy overlay module
requirements.description: src/utils/HTTPTransport.ts gains a static injectable TransportPolicy — onUnauthorized?(url): Promise<boolean> (true = refresh succeeded, replay once), onServerErrorDelay?(url, attempt): number | null (pure lookup), onRetryOverlay?(phase: 'begin'|'end', kind: 'unauthorized'|'server-error'): void, beforeUnauthorizedRetry?(options): void — installed via HTTPTransport.setTransportPolicy(). EXCLUSION (review F-3, narrowed): only the specific auth endpoints whose 401/403 are semantic or recursive are never intercepted — a URL ending in /auth/refresh, /auth/login, /auth/register, /auth/logout or /auth/logout-all. Everything else IS intercepted, including /auth/me, /auth/profile and /auth/password (the profile feature rides the same /auth prefix and its saves MUST be healed on stale access). OVERLAY LIFECYCLE (review F-1, balanced pairs): the transport emits onRetryOverlay('begin', kind) exactly ONCE per interception PHASE and 'end' exactly once when that phase settles — 401 phase: begin → onUnauthorized → (true: end, then replay) / (false, missing policy or hook rejection: end, reject the ORIGINAL error); 5xx phase: begin → retry loop → end on resolve, delay-null stop or exhaustion. A replay that 500s after a healed 401 opens a NEW balanced 5xx pair; every begin is paired with exactly one end on every terminal path. NEW src/utils/busyOverlay.ts: imperative lazy DOM module — show(kind: 'wait'|'reconnect') refcounts up and creates the node on first call (fixed full-screen dimming layer, spinner ring, role=status aria-live=polite, caption per kind VERBATIM: wait = «Пожалуйста, ожидайте» + THREE separate animated dot spans (CSS pulse with staggered delays), reconnect = «Возможно, проблемы на сервере.. Мы пробуем переподключиться» including the «..» and the space); hide() decrements and removes the node at zero — with a GRACE TEARDOWN (review F-1: the removal is deferred by a macrotask and cancelled by the next show, so the 401→5xx phase transition never flashes); the caption follows the most recent show. NEW src/scss/components/busy-overlay.scss registered in src/scss/components/_all.scss (no comments). Tests: HTTPTransport.test.ts (fake XHR + fake timers: 401 replay once incl. options mutation; false → original 401; the five excluded endpoints never trigger policy hooks while /auth/me, /auth/profile and /auth/password DO; 5xx delays 2/6/12s then 4th failure rejects; intermediate 200 resolves; null delay stops; 401-replay→500 composition; hook rejection degrades to false; begin/end BALANCED on every path incl. success and composition; every suite that installs a policy resets it via HTTPTransport.setTransportPolicy(null) in afterEach — review F-4) and busyOverlay.test.ts (node lifecycle, verbatim captions, three dot spans present, refcount, kind switch, removal at zero, grace teardown cancels on re-show).
requirements.source: operator request 2026-11-03 (401 refresh+replay, 500 retry, overlay with animated dots)

requirements.title: Auth feature transport policy (single-flight refresh, kick-out) + binding + docs
requirements.description: NEW src/features/auth/transportPolicy.ts exports createAuthTransportPolicy(): TransportPolicy and installAuthTransportPolicy() (calls HTTPTransport.setTransportPolicy(createAuthTransportPolicy()) — the seam features/index.ts invokes next to the existing consumer-side setters). ONE OVERLAY OWNER (review F-2): only onRetryOverlay touches busyOverlay — onUnauthorized NEVER calls show/hide directly; its refresh POST runs inside try/finally with NO overlay concerns. onRetryOverlay impl: begin → showBusyOverlay(kind === 'unauthorized' ? 'wait' : 'reconnect') DEFERRED by a macrotask and cancelled if the paired end arrives first (an instantly-resolved interception — e.g. the csrf-empty fast-fail — must not flash the overlay; review F-2), end → hideBusyOverlay() (only when the deferred show actually fired). onUnauthorized: (1) RECENTLY-REFRESHED WINDOW (review F-8 race): if a refresh succeeded within the last 2000ms, resolve true IMMEDIATELY with no network — a 401 arriving just after a completed rotation replays with the fresh access cookie instead of firing a second rotation that would answer refresh_token_rotated and wrongly kick the user out; (2) SINGLE-FLIGHT: one shared refresh promise created once, cleared in finally — rotation is one-shot, two parallel refreshes would guarantee refresh_token_rotated and an unwanted kick-out; (3) absent csrf cookie (readCsrfToken() === '') resolves false IMMEDIATELY with no network call; (4) otherwise POST /auth/refresh via the auth http client with the current csrf token → true on success, remembering the success timestamp for the window; (5) on ANY failure clear the session locally (authSlice.setUser(null)), fire best-effort POST /auth/logout (errors swallowed), Router.go(SIGNIN), resolve false. onServerErrorDelay: SERVER_ERROR_RETRY_DELAYS_MS = [2000, 6000, 12000], attempts beyond → null. beforeUnauthorizedRetry: options.csrfToken = readCsrfToken() (rotation reissued chatty_csrf; a non-GET replay with the stale token would 403). SINGLE REFRESH MECHANISM (review F-3 consequence): with /auth/me now intercepted globally, meWithRefresh in features/auth/api/own.ts becomes dead code and is REMOVED (replaced by me: async () => toAuthUser((await http.get('/me')) as OwnUserResponse) — the toAuthUser mapping is spelled out because the literal shorthand would silently bypass the display_name/avatar fallbacks under the Promise<never> signature, review N-3); its api tests are updated accordingly — cold boot heals through the same policy (deferred show keeps the common case flash-free; on a fully dead session the fast-fail path makes no network call). Docs: docs/progress/progress_log.md entry on top. Tests: transportPolicy.test.ts (two concurrent onUnauthorized share ONE refresh POST — single-flight stub; recently-refreshed window → true with zero http calls; success → true; failure → setUser(null) + Router.go(SIGNIN) + false and NO overlay leak — deferred show cancelled by the paired end; empty csrf → false with zero http calls; delay ladder 2000/6000/12000/null; onRetryOverlay kind→caption mapping incl. the deferred-show cancellation; beforeUnauthorizedRetry re-reads the cookie; installAuthTransportPolicy binding asserted with a sinon stub on HTTPTransport.setTransportPolicy; every suite installing a policy resets it with setTransportPolicy(null) in afterEach — review F-4).
requirements.source: operator request 2026-11-03 (kick-out when refresh fails; wire the overlay)

specification.goal: An expired access cookie no longer breaks the session: any 401 except on the five semantic auth endpoints is transparently healed by one shared refresh and the failed request is replayed; a failed refresh kicks the user to sign-in; 5xx responses retry under a full-screen dimming spinner overlay with the two verbatim captions; the backend refresh contract is pinned by integration tests.
constraints: Layers only downward; HTTPTransport (utils) learns the TransportPolicy interface only and never imports features/Store/Router; the policy implementation lives in features/auth; the overlay is a utils DOM module; binding is a consumer-side seam in features/index.ts; guard-architecture --all --strict stays 0.

Only /auth/refresh, /auth/login, /auth/register, /auth/logout and /auth/logout-all are excluded from interception (no refresh recursion, no retry storms on the login/register forms); /auth/me, /auth/profile and /auth/password ARE intercepted like every other request (review F-3).

Overlay begin/end are balanced per interception phase on every terminal path; busyOverlay is the ONLY refcounted visual and has exactly one driver (the policy's onRetryOverlay) — onUnauthorized never touches it (reviews F-1, F-2).
Every test suite that installs a transport policy resets it via HTTPTransport.setTransportPolicy(null) in afterEach (review F-4 — static global state under alphabetical mocha ordering).
Backend application code (backend/app/**) is a forbidden write; the backend workstream adds tests only.
Overlay captions are verbatim operator copy including punctuation; the three dots of the wait caption are separate animated spans.
No comments in new/edited scss (stylelint); imports with .ts extension; eslint:fix/stylelint:fix before commit.
Existing suites stay green; mocha counts grow from the 568 base, pytest from the 253 base; no store-shape, WS-protocol, routing or dependency changes.
nonGoals: no preemptive refresh timer (refresh stays reactive on 401)
no WS-connection or bot-run retry changes (the existing network/timeout bot retry stays; bot/runs 5xx simply inherits the global retry)
no auth store shape or guard behavior changes (meWithRefresh is removed as dead code — its behavior is subsumed by the global policy)
no backend application code changes (tests only; a discovered defect is a plan gap)
no overlay on the login/register surfaces and no i18n layer
specification.scope: transport policy hooks + busy overlay module/scss with unit tests (utils); auth-feature policy implementation with single-flight refresh, kick-out and csrf re-read + binding + progress log (features/auth, features/index.ts); backend refresh-contract integration suite (backend/tests/integration/auth); evidence under work/2026-11-03-auth-refresh-retry/.

criteria.title: Refresh contract pinned by pytest
criteria.statement: The httpx integration suite proves: login issues all three cookies; refresh with csrf rotates (reissued cookies; replay of the previous refresh cookie → 401 refresh_token_rotated); missing refresh cookie → 401 refresh_required; missing csrf header → 403 csrf_failed; GET /chats 401 authentication_required without the access cookie and 401 invalid_token with a corrupted one, 200 after refresh; logout retires the refresh cookie. npm run verify:backend exits 0 with pytest counts grown from the 253 base.

criteria.title: 401 replay + 5xx retry + overlay proven by mocha

securityGates.statement: Rotation is one-shot: two parallel refreshes would answer refresh_token_rotated and kick the user out. The policy MUST share one refresh promise across concurrent 401s (created once, cleared in finally); mocha pins one refresh POST for two concurrent calls.

Only /auth/refresh, /auth/login, /auth/register, /auth/logout and /auth/logout-all are excluded from interception: no refresh recursion, no 5xx retry storms on the login/register forms (which could mass-create accounts or mask invalid_credentials); /auth/me, /auth/profile and /auth/password stay healed (review F-3); mocha pins zero policy-hook calls for the five excluded endpoints and healing for the other three.

A failed runtime refresh clears the local session (setUser(null)), fires a best-effort logout and redirects to SIGNIN; the caller still receives the ORIGINAL 401 error (refresh internals never leak); an absent csrf cookie short-circuits to false without network traffic; the overlay is guaranteed to be dismissed on this path (single owner + balanced pairs + deferred show, reviews F-1/F-2); the 2000ms recently-refreshed window prevents a stale-401 race from triggering a second rotation and a wrongful kick-out (review F-8).

Before the 401 replay the outgoing options re-read the csrf cookie (rotation reissued chatty_csrf; a non-GET replay with the stale token would 403); mocha pins the mutation via beforeUnauthorizedRetry.
